verdict.rationale: Column offers webhooks, idempotency, and holds as general API automation primitives (column-docs-7, column-docs-14, column-docs-22), but there is no evidence of any AI-native automation-setup capability — no agent orchestration layer, scheduled/recurring workflow builder, or natural-language automation configuration that would let an AI-native user set up autonomous background automations. This is a fair axis for a payments API platform, but the pack shows only generic developer-facing webhooks, not an automation/agent framework.
